heading: Registers; preference eligibles who resigned
lead: A preference eligible who resigns, on request to the Office of Personnel Management, is entitled to have his name placed again on all registers for which he may have been qualified, in the order named by section 3313 of this title.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes DerivationU.S. CodeRevised Statutes andStatutes at Large 5 U.S.C. 865.June 27, 1944, ch. 287, § 16, 58 Stat. 391. The last 28 words of former section 865 relating to recertification and reappointments are omitted since under sections 3317 and 3318(a) certification and appointment follow from placing on registers. Standard changes are made to conform with the definitions applicable and the style of this title as outlined in the preface to the report.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1978—Pub. L. 95–454 substituted “Office of Personnel Management” for “Civil Service Commission”.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 1978 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 95–454 effective 90 days after Oct. 13, 1978, see section 907 of Pub. L. 95–454, set out as a note under section 1101 of this title.
